high_level_description: The image depicts a person sitting on a light-colored couch in a softly lit room. The individual has long, wavy hair that cascades over their shoulders. They are wearing a white t-shirt and dark pants, with one leg bent and the other extended, creating a relaxed posture. The person is accessorized with a bracelet on their left wrist. The background features beige curtains that allow natural light to filter into the room, casting a warm glow. There are two pillows on the couch, adding to the cozy ambiance of the setting.
